insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Vi is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Vi in 54/109 games (50%): 5 picks (1-4) and 49 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Rumble? They go Renekton
insights.text: Rumble is a G1 favorite (15/42 G1s, played by PerfecT). In the 45 later games where it was burned or banned, PerfecT went to Renekton (9/45) and Sion (8/45).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they go about as deep as the league
insights.text: In 25 G3+ games, 39/125 picks (31%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 31%). Pool: 54 champs in G1s, 62 in G3+.
